source_boundary: Manufacturer information anchors a reproducible scenario model; none of the outputs are measured industrial plant results.

1 bar per-element and 3.5 bar per-vessel maximum pressure drop
sources.interpretation: A/B fit uses one typical test point. Fit is not independent validation. Product quality gate does not establish pathogen/boron safety.

sources.title: DuPont FilmTec Technical Manual, normalization equations 73-76
used_for: Water temperature factor exp[K(1/298 - 1/(273+T))] with K=2640 above 25 C and 3020 below
Practical osmotic-pressure approximation in bar: c_mgL(T+320)/491000 below 20000 mg/L; ((0.0117c_mgL-34)/14.23)((T+320)/345) above
sources.interpretation: A practical total-salt approximation, not an ion-resolved seawater chemistry model. The search parse repeats a less-than sign for the high-salinity branch; the older official normalization excerpt confirms greater-than 20000.

sources.title: DuPont Plant Performance Normalization, Form 45-D01616-en Rev10, February2022
used_for: Confirm low/high-salinity branches and temperature normalization
sources.interpretation: Normalization helps comparison; it does not identify the cause of a change by itself.
